author: Blackware
body:
My Appeal for Unban

  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) : Markozarko
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned : Using All kinds of Hacks to make me better. Why ? It was 1-2years ago and im not hacking anymore...
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. : Because im not hacking anymore. It was a fault. It was wrong. Yes it was. I was a small little kid.... Its been 2 years now.
  • For me i think i have waited long enough for an unban (2years)
  • I Have never appealed for an unban before

replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
Hello markozarko! I have decided to appeal your ban, since you have waited over a year. Welcome back to the server!

Please read the rules at avicus.net/rules to ensure you don't break anymore rules! :)
